Date: 2026-10-22. Base commit: `3e8763e` on `main` (0.2.4-dev). The range under review is `191cc15..3e8763e`;
skip `.collab/`. New: `crates/c3/src/update/mod.rs`, `crates/c3/src/cli/update.rs`, `crates/c3-cli/tests/update.rs`,
`docs/port/wave11-update.md`; changed: `c3config.rs` (`update_check`, `source_checkout`), `hook/mod.rs` (one more line),
the plugin hook wrappers, `c3-cli/src/main.rs`, `cli/mod.rs`, README "Updating C3", `plugin/README.md`, CHANGELOG
`[Unreleased / 0.2.4-dev]`. Also a `cargo fmt` pass over four `work/` files (formatting only).

## What it does (operator's ask: "C3 should check for and pull its updates, or at least offer them")

- **Check**: the newest `v<semver>` tag of `github.com/xelth-com/C3` through the tags API (`/repos/xelth-com/C3/tags`,
  unauthenticated GET, `User-Agent: c3/<version>`, https only, no redirects followed, 3 s timeout - the priors
  download `Fetcher`/`UreqFetcher` reused unchanged), at most once per 24 h, cached atomically at
  `<codex home>/c3/update-check.json` `{checked_at, latest, latest_sha, installed, source}`; a failed fetch keeps the
  previous cache. Default ON; off with `C3_UPDATE_CHECK=off` or config `"update_check": false`; under
  `CODEX_CONSULT_TEST_MODE=1` no network (a tags file via `C3_UPDATE_TEST_TAGS_FILE`, else "offline").
- **Offer**: `c3 hook` prints one extra LAST line only when a newer tag exists:
  `c3: update available v<latest> (installed <installed>) - review: https://github.com/xelth-com/C3/blob/v<latest>/CHANGELOG.md ; apply: c3 update --apply`;
  any error = no line; startup/resume/compact output otherwise byte-identical (the wrappers forward `c3:` lines).
- **`c3 update` / `--check`**: forces a check now, prints installed, latest, status, changelog URL, the install kind
  and the exact commands `--apply` would run, "nothing was changed."; exit 0 up to date / 3 update exists / 1 fetch
  failure (reason, never a secret). Live today: latest v0.2.2 on GitHub (v0.2.3 is not pushed), installed 0.2.3 -> "up
  to date", exit 0.
- **`c3 update --apply`**: (a) `cargo install --git https://github.com/xelth-com/C3.git --tag v<latest> --locked c3-cli`
  (+ `--features index-surreal` when the running binary has it) - touches no checkout; (b) only if a source checkout
  is known (config `source_checkout`, env `C3_SOURCE_CHECKOUT`, or the plugin root's parent when it is a git work
  tree with `plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` naming c3) AND `git status --porcelain` is empty AND HEAD is on a
  branch: `git fetch --tags origin` + `git merge --ff-only v<latest>`; dirty / detached / non-ff = printed and
  skipped, (a) stands; (c) `claude plugin update c3@c3` if `claude` is on PATH, else the command is printed. Refused
  when up to date (exit 0) or after a fetch failure (exit 1). The plan is a pure `Vec<Step>` run by a thin streaming
  runner; tests never run cargo or git for real.

## Checks run

| check | command | exit | observation |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspace | `cargo test -j 2 --workspace --no-fail-fast` | 0 | all sets green (worker's run) |
| update | `cargo test -p c3 --lib update`; `-p c3-cli --test update -- --test-threads=1` | 0 | 9 + 8 passed |
| hook / router / c3config | `cargo test -p c3 --lib hook`, `router`, `c3config`; `-p c3-cli hook` | 0 | 6, 7, 6, 2 passed; priors unchanged |
| clippy / fmt | `--all-targets`; `cargo fmt --check` | 0 | 0 warnings; clean |
| live | `cargo run -p c3-cli -- update` | 0 | real GitHub tags path works; cache written |

## Reading budget

No sub-agents; never print a whole file; at most 5 tool calls; the verdict even on an incomplete read. Suggested
order: `crates/c3/src/update/mod.rs` (`plan`, `inspect_checkout`, `run_apply`, the cache write, `hook_line`), then
`crates/c3/src/hook/mod.rs` diff, then `docs/port/wave11-update.md`.

## Questions

- **Q1.** Supply-chain and safety of `--apply`: `cargo install --git --tag` over https with no release signature
  (none exists yet) - acceptable for an explicit operator action, or must `--apply` first verify the tag's commit
  sha against the API's `latest_sha` (and how, given `cargo install --git` hides the checkout)? Anything in the
  checkout steps (b) that can damage an operator's work tree?
- **Q2.** The offer path: can the hook line mislead (stale cache, a tag pushed then deleted, a pre-release tag, a
  downgrade when the installed version is ahead of the newest tag), and is the 24 h / 3 s / default-on choice right
  for a SessionStart hook?
- **Q3.** Verdict: ACCEPT (ship in 0.2.4), HOLD (blockers by id), or ADVISE.

Answer by number. Keep it under 200 words.

+# Wave 11 — `c3 update` (self-update check and apply)
+
+C3 checks whether a newer release of itself exists and offers it; it applies only on an explicit
+`--apply`. New subcommand `c3 update` plus one extra line in the SessionStart hook.
+
+## Source of truth
+
+The git **tags** of `https://github.com/xelth-com/C3`, read through the unauthenticated tags API
+`https://api.github.com/repos/xelth-com/C3/tags` (JSON array `[{"name":"v0.2.3","commit":{"sha":…}},…]`).
+The newest release is the highest semver among names of the form `v<major>.<minor>.<patch>`
+(anything else is ignored), compared with `env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")`.
+
+## Module map
+
+- `crates/c3/src/update/mod.rs` — version parse/compare, the tags API, the cache, install-kind
+  detection, the apply plan (`Vec<Step>`, pure and testable) and the thin runner, plus
+  `run_check_report` / `run_apply` and `hook_line`.
+- `crates/c3/src/cli/update.rs` — the clap surface (`--check` / `--apply`) and dispatch.
+- Wiring: `crates/c3/src/lib.rs`, `crates/c3/src/cli/mod.rs`, `crates/c3-cli/src/main.rs`.
+- `crates/c3/src/c3config.rs` — two new config keys: `update_check` (bool, default **true**) and
+  `source_checkout` (string path).
+- `crates/c3/src/hook/mod.rs` — prints the update line last; `plugin/hooks/c3-hook.{ps1,sh}` forward
+  a line starting `c3: update available ` (alongside the `codex-consult:` lines they already
+  forward).
+
+## Fetch, cache, off switch
+
+- **Fetcher.** Reuses the priors `Fetcher` trait and `UreqFetcher` from
+  `crates/c3/src/router/download.rs` (`User-Agent: c3/<version>`, https only, `.redirects(0)`, 3 s
+  timeout, no cookies/query). The priors behaviour is unchanged.
+- **Cache.** `<codex home>/c3/update-check.json`
+  (`{checked_at, latest, latest_sha, installed, source:"github-tags"}`), written atomically
+  (temp + rename). A check is attempted at most once per 24 h; a failed fetch keeps the previous
+  cache and is silent in the hook (reported only by `c3 update`). Clock: `Utc::now()`.
+- **Off switch (default ON).** `C3_UPDATE_CHECK=off` or `"update_check": false`. In
+  `CODEX_CONSULT_TEST_MODE=1` no network is ever touched: the fetcher reads the tags JSON from
+  `C3_UPDATE_TEST_TAGS_FILE` when set, else reports "offline".
+
+## The hook line
+
+```
+c3: update available v<latest> (installed <installed>) - review: https://github.com/xelth-com/C3/blob/v<latest>/CHANGELOG.md ; apply: c3 update --apply
+```
+
+Printed only when the (24 h) cache says a newer version exists; startup/resume/compact output is
+otherwise byte-identical. The hook never exceeds its budget or fails: any error prints no line.
+
+## `c3 update`
+
+- No flags / `--check`: force a check now (ignoring the 24 h age, still writing the cache), print
+  installed vs latest, whether an update exists, the changelog URL, the install kind detected, the
+  exact commands `--apply` would run, and `nothing was changed.` Exit `0` up to date, `3` an update
+  exists, `1` on a fetch failure (reason: a status code or "offline", never a secret).
+- `--apply`: run, streaming child output, stopping at the first failure — (a)
+  `cargo install --git … --tag v<latest> --locked c3-cli` (+ `--features index-surreal` when the
+  running binary has that feature); (b) a **clean** source checkout on a branch is
+  `git fetch --tags origin` + `git merge --ff-only v<latest>` (a dirty tree / detached HEAD / non-ff
+  is printed and skipped, never failing (a)); (c) `claude plugin update c3@c3` when `claude` is on
+  PATH, else the command is printed. Refused when up to date (exit 0) or the fetch failed (exit 1).
+
+## Never
+
+Run on its own without `--apply`; touch a dirty checkout; follow a redirect; send anything but the
+GET; write outside `<codex home>/c3/`. There is no release signature yet: `cargo install --git
+--tag` trusts GitHub's HTTPS transport and the tag.

+## Updating C3
+
+C3 checks whether a newer release of itself exists and tells you — it never updates on its own.
+The source of truth is the git **tags** of this repository, read once a day through the
+unauthenticated GitHub tags API (`https://api.github.com/repos/xelth-com/C3/tags`); the newest
+release is the highest `v<major>.<minor>.<patch>` tag, compared with the running binary's version.
+
+- **The offer.** The SessionStart hook prints one extra line when a newer release is on record:
+  `c3: update available v<latest> (installed <installed>) - review:
+  https://github.com/xelth-com/C3/blob/v<latest>/CHANGELOG.md ; apply: c3 update --apply`. It
+  refreshes the cached answer at most once every 24 h, within a 3 s budget, and is silent on any
+  failure — a broken or offline check never delays or breaks a session.
+- **The check.** `c3 update` (or `c3 update --check`) forces a check now and prints the installed
+  and latest versions, whether an update exists, the changelog URL, the install kind it detected,
+  and the exact commands `--apply` *would* run — then changes nothing. It exits `0` when up to
+  date, `3` when an update exists (so a script can branch) and `1` on a fetch failure.
+- **Applying.** `c3 update --apply` installs, stopping at the first failure: (a)
+  `cargo install --git https://github.com/xelth-com/C3.git --tag v<latest> --locked c3-cli`
+  (plus `--features index-surreal` when the running binary was built with the indexed bundle); (b)
+  if a **clean** source checkout is known (config `source_checkout`, env `C3_SOURCE_CHECKOUT`, or
+  the git work tree around `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT`), `git fetch --tags origin` then
+  `git merge --ff-only v<latest>` — a dirty tree, a detached HEAD or a non-fast-forward is printed
+  and skipped, never failing (a); (c) `claude plugin update c3@c3` when `claude` is on PATH, else it
+  prints that command to run by hand. It refuses when you are already up to date or the check
+  failed, and never touches a dirty checkout.
+- **The off switch (default ON).** Set `C3_UPDATE_CHECK=off`, or `"update_check": false` in
+  `<codex home>/c3/config.json`, to silence the automatic hook check. `c3 update` run by hand still
+  checks. Nothing here is ever written outside `<codex home>/c3/`, no redirect is ever followed, and
+  nothing but the plain GET is ever sent.
+- **Unsigned-tag limitation.** `cargo install --git --tag` fetches the tagged source over HTTPS from
+  GitHub and builds it locally; there is **no release signature** to verify yet. The trust you are
+  extending is to GitHub's transport and to the `xelth-com/C3` tag, exactly as for a manual
+  `cargo install --git`. Signed releases are future work.
+
